capabilities: Crawl a website into per-page Markdown notes with locally saved images
Map the site as an interactive 3D globe with Road and Clusters views
Run a site audit with health card, charts and a findings list
Generate a task list of findings that persists across captures
Compare two captured sites and publish approved client reports
disambiguation: Not just a 3D visualization toy; its main job is crawling a website into Markdown notes, with the globe and audit built on top of that capture.
extras: Desktop only (does not work on mobile). Requires the user to install and configure Python themselves; diagnostics command helps fix setup. Warns users to only capture sites they are allowed to read and to respect robots.txt. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture a whole website's pages as offline Markdown notes or to see and audit how those pages connect.

relations.evidence: The optional browser step uses Playwright with Chromium.

requires.name: Optional Python packages: dnspython, pyspellchecker, html5lib

summary: Website crawler that saves a site's pages as clean Markdown notes in your vault and maps its structure on an interactive 3D globe with a site audit.
